name: Heinbockel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Heinbockel (a megalithic tomb on yellow above a yellow pot on green).
history: Municipal flag of Heinbockel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Heinbockel arms — megalithic tomb and pot
